bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge code, hmac.idle_o was hardwired to 1'b1 with a TBD comment, so the HMAC module always reported idle even while a hash/HMAC operation was active, message data was still in the FIFO, or the SHA-256 core was still processing. The specification requires idle_o to be asserted only when no operation is active, the message FIFO is empty, the HMAC sequencer is idle, and the SHA-2 engine is idle. The root cause is that the idle status was not actually generated: the top level did not combine the packer/FIFO/core statuses, and hmac_core and sha2 did not expose or compute their own idle conditions.
bug_info.fix_hint: Replace the constant idle_o assignment with a real idle condition. In hmac_core, compute idle as being in StIdle with no hash_start. In sha2, compute idle as both the FIFO and SHA state machines being idle with no hash_start. At the top level, assert idle_o only when the packer is not producing valid output, the message FIFO has no valid read data, hmac_core reports idle, and sha2 reports idle, and register the result so it resets to 1.
